verdict.rationale: CAM's Private Equity page explicitly claims support 'from fund formation to growth transactions, PIPE deals, buyouts, going-private transactions, and exits' and cites concrete stand-out M&A deals (e.g., the USD 1.6B Rajasthan Royals acquisition, Hygenco's capital raise), showing real M&A/exit credentials for VC-backed-style deals. However, there is no dedicated page or documented track record specifically for public offerings/IPOs of venture-backed companies — missing for 10: explicit IPO/public-offering practice documentation, named venture-backed IPO deal examples, and any capital-markets page tying IPO work to startup/VC clients.
